---
title: "🗓️ New NHL season: switch stickpicks over"
---
The NHL usually posts next season's schedule in early July. Once it's out:

- [ ] **Set the season** in `config.js` (`SEASON`, e.g. `"20272028"`). That's the one place; everything else follows.
- [ ] **Add the new season's ticket badge** (e.g. `season2728`) to `BADGES` in `teams.js` with its own art, plus
      `BADGE_ORDER`, the "Getting started" group and the share phrases. The database already handles any `seasonNNNN` id.
- [ ] **Move dated shop items** to the new season's dates (Frozen Pond, and anything else with `available_from`/`available_to`).
- [ ] **Push, then run "Update NHL games" once** (Actions → Update NHL games → Run workflow) to load the new schedule.
- [ ] **Check the home page** shows the new season's games and the leaderboards start fresh.
- [ ] **Wrapped:** share last season's recap with players before the new one starts (once the Wrapped feature exists).

Last season's games, picks and trophy cases stay in the database. Full notes: "New-season checklist" in CLAUDE.md.

_Opened automatically by the reminders workflow (.github/reminders/07-01.md)._
